newsitem.title: JAPAN: TIFFE Euroyen hits contract high after output data.
newsitem.headline: TIFFE Euroyen hits contract high after output data.

text.p: The key March three-month Euroyen futures contract set a new contract high of 99.16 on TIFFE on Wednesday afternoon, following the release of Japanese industrial output data, traders said.
The March broke through major resistance at 99.14, helped by heavy bids from traders cheered by the data. It closed at 99.11 on Tuesday.
The Trade Ministry said June industrial output was down a preliminary 3.1 percent month-on-month, compared with market forecasts ranging from minus 1.2 to minus four.
It said it expects manufacturers' output to rise 1.3 percent in July against June and to fall 0.5 percent in August against July.
